transcript.text: We offer a free 30-minute consultation with one of our trained aesthetic practitioners to discuss your goals and recommend a treatment plan.
Yes, our consultations are completely free of charge. They're a great opportunity to discuss your goals and receive personalized recommendations from one of our practitioners.
Great, I'd like to book one. I'm free Saturdays.

We're open Monday to Saturday, so that works well. To book a consultation, you can either book via WhatsApp or through our website at www.bloomaesthetics.com. Would you like me to guide you through the booking process?

summary.customer_intent: The customer inquired about consultations and expressed interest in booking a free consultation.
summary.recommended_next_action: Book free consultation via WhatsApp or website
summary.notes: Customer is interested in booking a consultation on a Saturday, which is within the clinic's operating hours.
